Hi,this is the ver1.0 of KTT Portraits.
Retexture portraits for all characters in SVE(but not junimos),and change the Lance&Scarlett's sprites a little bit.
For guys who supported me before,thank you.I decide to republish the two parts(portraits for SVE and Xtardew Valley)separately,so you can choose easier.

[size=4][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS⬇[/b][/size]
[size=3]1 .Download and install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] [/size]and its requirements;
2 .Download and unzip my mod into the same folder you installed SVE;
3 .Overwrite all files when prompted.
※.Due to Gil/Guther/Marlon are vaniila NPCs,in some events my portraits may not working.I put their XNBs in my folder,you can use them to overwrite the former files(put into the file named "Portraits"→  steamapps＞common＞Stardew Valley＞Content＞Portraits).
※.Back up before.

ENJOY!
